video_specification.overview: Produce a {DURATION_SECONDS}-second {TONE} video about {TOPIC}. Rendered as MP4 at 1920x1080 30fps with Remotion. Narration is continuous ElevenLabs voiceover. Each shot agent chooses its own visual treatment independently by reading the remotion-best-practices skill (available at docs/remotion-rules/) and the design-skill guideline (at docs/remotion-design-skill.md). There is no shared palette, no shared typography, and no shared composition grammar — shots are intentionally diverse.

prerequisites.environment_setup: - ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is exported - ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID optionally overrides the default voice - Node 20+ and pnpm are available - The Remotion project is pre-scaffolded by the harness driver - public/assets/ contains Wikipedia-sourced reference images (see assets.json) - docs/remotion-rules/ contains the full remotion-best-practices skill (see docs/remotion-rules/INDEX.md) - docs/remotion-design-skill.md contains the "go bold" design philosophy for this pipeline

technology_stack.audio_format: MP3 from ElevenLabs, served from public/audio.mp3
technology_stack.captions: NONE — no on-screen captions or subtitles

video_specification.narrative_arc:
{NARRATIVE_ARC_PROSE}
Three to five sentences describing what the audience learns, in order, and where the emphasis beats are. Phase A (downstream) reads this to write narration and decide phrase cuts. Do NOT write the literal voiceover here.
video_specification.topic_notes:
{OPTIONAL_DOMAIN_FACTS_OR_PROPER_NOUNS}
Optional. Proper nouns, domain facts, or concrete referents that downstream agents might not know. Helps shot agents pick topic-specific visual concepts.

hard_rules.rule: Every frame has continuous motion. No static frames.
No on-screen text mirrors the spoken voiceover. Structural text (big numeric headlines, chart axis labels, data values) is fine.
Frame integrity is fixed by TTS phrase alignment. Shot boundaries and anchor frames cannot be changed by shot agents.

step.title: Phase A — Director
step.tasks: Read video_spec.xml, write script.json (narration + phrases + anchors), stop.

step.title: Phase Assets
step.tasks: Asset scout picks Wikipedia-searchable terms; driver downloads images to public/assets/.

step.title: TTS
step.tasks: Driver synthesizes narration via ElevenLabs, derives shot frame ranges from phrases.

step.title: Phase B — Shot components (parallel, max 5 concurrent)
step.tasks: - One shot agent per timing.shots[i] - Each reads docs/remotion-design-skill.md + 1-3 rule files from docs/remotion-rules/ - Each writes src/shots/Shot{NN}.tsx + Shot{NN}.anchors.json - Each picks its own palette, typography, composition, technique

step.title: Phase C — Compositor
step.tasks: Assemble src/Root.tsx with Audio + shot Sequences, run alignment test, render to out/video.mp4.

success_criteria.functionality: - alignment.test.ts passes - out/video.mp4 exists - No on-screen text mirrors the voiceover - No static frames - Shots are visibly diverse from each other (no monotony)
